thematic_area: 5. Legal and Policy Framework / Access to Justice
name: Number of Laws enacted or amended
description: The total number of laws enacted or amended during the reporting period to strengthen the prevention of and response to violence against women and children (VAWC) and improve access to justice.

thematic_area: 5. Legal and Policy Framework / Access to Justice
name: Number of policies, strategies and guidelines developed or reviewed
description: The total number of policies, strategies, and operational guidelines developed or revised to support the implementation of NPA-VAWC II interventions.

thematic_area: 5. Legal and Policy Framework / Access to Justice
name: Number of law enforcement officers and other personel trained on VAWC laws and gender-responsive justice
description: The total number of law enforcement and justice sector personnel who completed training on VAWC laws, child protection, gender-responsive justice and survivor-centred service delivery during the reporting period.

thematic_area: 5. Legal and Policy Framework / Access to Justice
name: Number of registered Legal Aid Service Providers
description: The total number of Legal Aid Service Providers and paralegals officially registered and authorized to provide legal aid services in accordance with the Legal Aid Act.

thematic_area: 5. Legal and Policy Framework / Access to Justice
name: Number of people reached with legal awareness campaigns and programme
description: The total number of individuals reached through legal awareness and public education activities on rights, laws, prevention of VAWC and access to justice.

thematic_area: 5. Legal and Policy Framework / Access to Justice
name: Number of women and children provided with legal aid services
description: The total number of women (18 years and above) and children (below 18 years) who received one or more legal aid services during the reporting period. Legal aid services include legal information, legal advice, legal representation, mediation, legal drafting, negotiation, referral, legal awareness, and other assistance provided in accordance with the Legal Aid Act

thematic_area: 5. Legal and Policy Framework / Access to Justice
name: Number of women and children survivors of VWAC received legal aid services of legal aid services at one stop centres
description: The total number of survivors, women and children, receive legal aid services at one-stop centres and othe centres

thematic_area: 5. Legal and Policy Framework / Access to Justice
name: Number of functional Legal Aid Desks established
description: The total number of Legal Aid Desks established and operational in Local Government Authorities according to the national legal aid operational standards.

thematic_area: 5. Legal and Policy Framework / Access to Justice
name: Percentage of VAWC cases determined/ concluded by courts
description: The percentage of reported Violence Against Women and Children (VAWC) cases that were concluded by competent courts during the reporting period, regardless of the outcome

thematic_area: 5. Legal and Policy Framework / Access to Justice
name: Number of periodic reports on VAWC submitted to national, regional and international human rights treaty bodies.
description: The total number of periodic reports prepared, validated and officially submitted by the Government during the reporting period to national, regional and international human rights reporting mechanisms that include information on the implementation of commitments related to the prevention of and response to Violence Against Women and Children (VAWC).

thematic_area: 5. Legal and Policy Framework / Access to Justice
name: Number of ICT systems/tools strengthened to support access to justice
description: The total number of digital systems, databases or ICT tools developed, upgraded or operationalized to improve access to justice, case management and reporting.

thematic_area: 5. Legal and Policy Framework / Access to Justice
name: Number of coordination meetings conducted
description: The total number of formal coordination meetings conducted during the reporting period to facilitate planning, implementation, monitoring, review and coordination of interventions related to the prevention and response to Violence Against Women and Children (VAWC) under NPA-VAWC II.

name: Number of Women who have experienced violence and seek help
description: Refers to the total number of women who have experienced any form of violence such as physical, sexual, psychological, or economic and have sought assistance or support services to police, healthcare providers, social services, legal aid, shelters and/or informal sources (e.g., family, friends, community leaders) desgregate by sex, type of vulnerability and disability status to all survivor

name: Number of children experienced sexual violence and seek help
description: Refers to the total number of children (under the age of 18) who have experienced any form of sexual violence including sexual abuse, exploitation, assault, or harassment and have sought assistance or protection to police, child protection services, healthcare providers, teachers, NGOs or informal sources (e.g., family members, friends, trusted adults). desgregate by sex and disability status to all survivors

name: Number of children’s victims of violence who seek and received services
description: Refers to the total number of women and children who have experienced any form of violence including physical, sexual, emotional/psychological, or economic and accessed and received at least one type of support service in response to the violence.Services include medical care, psychosocial support, legal aid, shelter, case management, and child protection services (this count for all type of violence therefore deseagregation is per type of violence, age, sex and disability status)

name: Number of healthcare facilities offering specialized VAWC services
description: This indicator refers to the total number of health facilities that provide survivor-centered services specifically designed to address the needs of women and children who are victims of violence.

name: Number of children placed in alternative care services
description: This indicator refers to the total number of children who have been placed in alternative care- arrangements outside of their biological family due to various reasons such as neglect, abuse, abandonment, or inability of the family to care for the child.These care services include foster care, residential care, kinship care (with relatives), or other state- or community-supported care settings. desgregate by sex,type of service and disability status to all survivors

name: Number of frontline workers trained to deliver quality VAWC service
description: This indicator refers to the total number of frontline workers (social workers, healthcare providers, police officers, legal personnel, educators, and community workers ) who have received training to effectively provide quality services related to the prevention, response, and management of violence against women and children (VAWC).

name: VAWC Number of data/inform ation manageme nt systems relevant for VAWC that are generating harmonized data and information
description: This indicator measures the total number of data or information management systems designed to collect, process, and manage data related to VAWC.

name: Number of Most Vulnerable Children identified,registered and service received
description: This indicator refers to the number of children classified as Most Vulnerable Children (MVCs) who have been identified through established assessment criteria and have subsequently received support services. MVCs typically include children affected by(desegration) extreme poverty, abuse, neglect, disability, HIV/AIDS, displacement, or the loss of parental care.

name: Number of Gender Desks formulated in market places
description: This indicator reflects the number of established Gender Desks within marketplaces to serve as a points for addressing gender-related issues, include reporting GBV cases, providing information on available services, support the safety of women and other vulnerable groups.

name: Number of Gender Desks formulated in middle and higher learning Institutions
description: This indicator refers to the number of established Gender Desks within n middle and higher learning Institutions to serve as a points for addressing gender-related issues, include reporting GBV cases, providing information on available services to support GBV victims

name: Number of Safe Houses formally established
description: This indicator measures the total number of Safe Houses that have been formally established and are operational to provide shelter, protection, and support services to individuals who are at risk of or have experienced violence, abuse, exploitation, or trafficking

name: Number of One Stop Center formulated
description: Refers to the total number of One Stop Centers (OSCs) that have been established and functional to provide integrated and comprehensive services including medical care, psychosocial support, legal aid, and police assistance to GBV, VAWC and VAC victims

name: Number of persons trained to provide care for children with protection concerns
description: This indicator mesures to the total number of individuals who have received formal training in order to care for and support children facing protection concerns.

name: Number of children accompanied their mothers in prisons
description: This indicator refers to the total number of children who are legally permitted to live with their mothers due to age limits defined by national laws or prison regulations

name: Number of people provided with Mental health and Psycho Social Care and Support
description: This indicator measures the total number of individuals who have received psychosocial care and support services include counseling, psychological first aid, emotional support, referral services, and social support interventions provided by trained social welfare officers, health workers

name: Number of schools that established confidential and safe reporting mechanisms
description: The number of schools that have established safe and confidential reporting mechanisms for cases of VAC, categorized by the type of mechanism used (e.g., suggestion boxes, trusted teacher, anonymous reporting systems).

name: Number of schools that established disability-friendly facilities
description: Number of schools that have established facilities that are accessible and inclusive for students with disabilities, ensuring they have equal access to education.

name: Number of schools with teaching and non- teaching staff trained on VAC prevention and response
description: The number of Schoools where teaching and non-teaching staff have received training on the prevention and response to VAC.

name: Number of schools with food programs for students in both primary and secondary schools
description: The number of primary and secondary Schools that provide food programs to support students' nutritional needs

name: Number of schools with active child protection desks
description: The number of Schools with trained teachers, students, system on Child Protection Desks

name: Number of school with WASH facilities
description: Number of schools with Safe Toilets, Girl hygiene rooms, Safe drinking water and handwashing facilities
